heading: Frequently Asked Questions
text2: Quick answers to the questions we hear most about this service.

items.question: Which VR platforms do you support?
items.answer: Oculus, Google VR and mixed reality devices, depending on your target audience.

items.question: Is VR development more expensive?
items.answer: It can be, because of 3D asset and optimization needs. We scope carefully to fit your budget.

items.question: How do you keep players comfortable?
items.answer: Comfort-focused locomotion, stable frame rates and careful scene design.

items.question: How long does virtual reality game development take?
items.answer: A simple casual game takes about 2 to 3 months, while a polished 3D or multiplayer game usually takes 6 months or more.

items.question: Do you offer support after launch?
items.answer: Yes. We provide maintenance, updates, monitoring and new feature development after launch.
